subject.title: fix(workspace): prevent false Missing labels on existing files and fix panel layout overlap

question: Should `sessions.files.list` ever expose existence, size, or mtime for transcript-mentioned paths outside the fs-safe workspace root?
rationale: That choice changes the session-file metadata security boundary; automation can flag the unsafe fallback, but maintainers need to decide whether external metadata is allowed or whether external entries should be filtered or shown with a non-sensitive state.

options.title: Keep session metadata inside fs-safe
options.body: Remove the raw filesystem fallback and solve the false badge with filtering or a neutral external state that does not stat outside the workspace.

options.title: Allow external metadata deliberately
options.body: Accept the external existence/size/mtime exposure only with explicit security approval plus tests and UI/protocol wording for the new behavior.

options.title: Split the layout repair
options.body: Keep the current-main CSS scroll fix and handle external-file semantics in the linked backend issue separately.

recommendation.title: Keep session metadata inside fs-safe
recommendation.body: Remove the raw filesystem fallback and solve the false badge with filtering or a neutral external state that does not stat outside the workspace.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the session workspace rail feature and are the clearest owner for the original Gateway/UI contract.
